title: fact_for skips a CSV header or a wrapped continuation line, so the last five path-only eval rows get a fact check
goal: fact_for never picks a CSV header line, a wrapped continuation line or a line that only points to another file, and reads a CSV data row as it reads an article line; three of the five eval rows left path-only after ST-ly2p27q3 (BP-90f14342, BP-f454bc83, BP-9e209bb8) and their variants get a fact check through pool build --redo under its breadth guard. The other two (BP-005970a5, BP-2413ce41) are parked as BG-wamgfo7s at the operator's choice of 2026-10-09.

run: import csv,json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_pool as bp; r={x['id']:x for x in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv'))}; bad=[i for i in ('BP-90f14342','BP-f454bc83','BP-9e209bb8','BP-d8203cfb','BP-fcb42c1f','BP-8bacbb0e') if bp.path_only(json.loads(r[i]['checks']))]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Committed to SP-7y6dk257 at the operator's request of 2026-10-09 (benchmark follow-ups): its five rows and their variants still pass on any answer naming the article. pool check passes before the work: it pins that the rebuilt pool stays well formed; the second check fails until the five rows hold a fact check.
